claim: No family (B0-B6/A/G) ever shows more than ~24 distinct placeholder atoms simultaneously within one row (B4 worst case: capacity K<=16 + up to 8 distinct decoy fillers; B5 worst case: N<=12) -- 46 is never a per-row capacity constraint for any existing family.

The 46 real accepted atom names (A-Z, 0-9, and 10 words: yes/no/true/false/maybe/unknown/if/then/not/and) and the 1 rejected name ('or') are already documented in-repo with provenance, sourced from a prior chatgpt-secondary research delta citing the ingested external XENO vector-language handoff (same abi/MANIFEST.json sha256 every family's ABI_MANIFEST_SHA256 constant already references).

A deterministic, hashlib-stratified 37/9 TRAIN_AND_VALIDATION/HOLDOUT_FROZEN split of the 46 real atom names, keeping both the neutral-alphanumeric and language-bearing strata represented on both sides of the split, closes the H_T2_ABI_03 requirement for a frozen immutable atom-split manifest before real rendering.

Of 195 distinct placeholder ordinals actually used across all 14 committed B0-B6 candidate JSONL files, zero cross the TRAIN/VALIDATION<->HOLDOUT_FROZEN boundary after excluding B4's known split-agnostic decoy range (80-99, verified by direct source inspection to never be a row's actual target).

remap_ordinal(family, ordinal, split_role) preserves split integrity across all 1170 (family x ordinal) combinations tested: every TRAIN/VALIDATION-role placeholder maps only into the TRAIN_AND_VALIDATION real-atom pool, every HOLDOUT-role placeholder maps only into the HOLDOUT_FROZEN pool, and decoys always map into TRAIN_AND_VALIDATION regardless of which split's row they appear in.

Exact atoms_index.json (atom-to-token-ID table), exact target tokenizer bytes/hash and exact renderer bytes/hash remain unresolved; TRIGGER2_ABI_CONTEXTUAL_RENDER_GATE/v1 stays SPECIFIED_NOT_EXECUTED. Namespace/design resolution does not imply real-binding resolution.
